{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Colonel Bris Dekker — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Colonel Bris Dekker]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Colonel Bris Dekker]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Colonel Bris Dekker]]'s Engineer services at Dekker's Yard in Sol.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Colonel Bris Dekker is discovered through [[Juri Ishmaak]].
* '''Invitation:''' Reach at least '''Friendly reputation with the Federation'''.
* Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Juri Ishmaak]].
* Obtain the Sol Permit by reaching '''Petty Officer''' or higher in Federal Navy Rank.
* Provide the required value of Federal combat bonds.
}}
== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Reach '''Grade 3 access and at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Juri Ishmaak]].
# Receive Juri's referral to Colonel Bris Dekker.
# Reach at least '''Friendly reputation with the Federation'''.
# Obtain the Sol Permit by reaching '''Petty Officer''' or higher in Federal Navy Rank.
# Accumulate enough '''Federal combat bonds''' for Bris's unlock requirement.
# Travel to '''Dekker's Yard''' on '''Iapetus''' in Sol.
# Provide the required value of Federal combat bonds.
# Enter the Engineer workshop and begin increasing your reputation with Bris.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Colonel Bris Dekker]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
